personal.name: Francesco Done'
personal.title: Senior Frontend Engineer & Software Architect
personal.tagline: Building scalable platforms, guiding engineering teams, and turning complex systems into reliable user experiences.
personal.bio: From London to Munich — building the web, one city at a time.
autobiography: My path through software has also been a path across Europe. It began with a first professional experience in London, continued through computer science studies in Padua and Milan, and expanded during an Erasmus exchange in Copenhagen.

After moving to Germany, I grew from frontend engineering into software architecture in Berlin and Stuttgart. Across every chapter, the constant has been curiosity: learning how systems work, how teams work together, and how technology can make complex experiences feel simple. I speak four languages — Italian, English, German, and Spanish — which helps me connect across cultures and perspectives. I have also been running since childhood, a discipline that shaped the competitive mindset I bring to everything I do.

journey.title: Senior Frontend Engineer & Software Architect
journey.description: Architecting the digital showroom for Mercedes-Benz. Designing scalable BFF architectures, leading micro-frontend migrations, pioneering AI-driven development, and receiving the Impact Award in 2024 and 2025.

highlights: Received the Impact Award in 2024 and 2025
Designed an AG-UI interface with custom AI agents for the digital showroom
Architected a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) data pipeline for vehicle discoverability across LLMs
Designed and implemented a scalable Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture
Introduced error budget policies aligning reliability with development velocity
Led SSR integration in a Vue3–AEM environment
Led Micro Frontend migration involving 40+ developers across 6 FE teams
Reduced bundle size by over 80%
Implemented FE monitoring with Datadog and Terraform, enabling On-Call-Duty across teams
Lowered CLS to quasi-0 in AEM environment
